app.title: VERDICT Response
app.subtitle: Offline-First Disaster Intelligence · Geo-Distributed Replication
app.simulatedNotice: Simulated demo data, not live disaster information
app.signatureNotice: A verified signature shows the record was signed by the associated key and not altered since. It does not show that the report itself is true.
app.certificateNotice: A certificate shows that the signing regions endorse a specific settled state for a specific round. Correctness comes from the versioned policy and invariant checks.

tooltips.source: Who submitted the report, authority tier, and channel. Tiers are defined by registry, not self-claimed.
tooltips.freshness: Age based on reported observation time. Flagged if future or abnormal.
tooltips.conflict: Whether contradictory reports exist for this location/entity.
tooltips.replication: Which regional stores have received and verified this record.
tooltips.integrity: Cryptographic Ed25519 hash chain and payload schema verification.
tooltips.resolution: Policy status: Tentative (local pending) vs Settled (certified round).

ack.device: Saved on device, not yet in region
